//: FRAGMENT fixture for the KPI HERO PANEL sub-component — the `.pa-kpi-hero-main` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.KpiHero.kpi_hero_main/1`, svelte `display/KpiHeroMain.svelte`). This is the headline-metric panel that lives inside a `.pa-kpi-hero-list__layout` (the container is covered by kpi-hero.json, which defers this block to THIS fixture via a fixture-ref). `.pa-kpi-hero-main` is a standalone block (hyphen-joined, NOT a `pa-kpi-hero-list__*` element) carrying its own sentiment modifiers (--positive/--negative/--neutral/--up-strong, which only re-point the `--pa-kpi-accent` cascade). Its parts are FLAT siblings under `pa-kpi-hero-main__`: __label, __value (wrapping __num + optional __unit/prefix), __meta (wrapping __delta · __period · __target). SCOPE = the text/structural shape BOTH wrappers agree on. The sparkline cell (__chart / __chart-svg) is DEFERRED prose: both wrappers feed chart content through a slot that the generic dumper passes as plain ESCAPED TEXT, and the real sparkline `<svg>` is native markup the author supplies — the SSR shells for that cell can't be exercised identically here. The detail popover (`.pa-kpi-detail`, shared by every KPI tile) is opt-in (renders only when a detail title/slot is set) and is a SEPARATE block covered by kpi-detail.json, so no scenario enables it. Authored from snippets/kpi.html L483-502 + _kpi-hero-supporting.scss.

propsVocabulary.variant: sentiment accent — pa-kpi-hero-main--{variant}; only re-points the --pa-kpi-accent cascade (delta + chart colour). Default (nil) emits NO modifier. svelte variant ('positive'|'negative'|'neutral'|'up-strong'); keen variant ('positive'|'negative'|'neutral'|'up-strong', dasherized from its underscored attr value — the dashed value passes through unchanged).
propsVocabulary.label: uppercase mono caption — pa-kpi-hero-main__label; renders only when set. svelte labelText; keen label_text.
propsVocabulary.value: focal numeric value — rendered as pa-kpi-hero-main__num inside the pa-kpi-hero-main__value wrapper. svelte valueText; keen value_text.
propsVocabulary.prefix: currency/scale prefix rendered BEFORE the number as a pa-kpi-hero-main__unit span. svelte prefix; keen prefix_text.
propsVocabulary.unit: unit suffix rendered AFTER the number as a pa-kpi-hero-main__unit span. svelte unit; keen unit_text.
propsVocabulary.delta: Δ text in the meta row — pa-kpi-hero-main__delta. svelte deltaText; keen delta_text.
propsVocabulary.period: period label in the meta row — pa-kpi-hero-main__period. svelte periodText; keen period_text.
propsVocabulary.target: target label in the meta row — pa-kpi-hero-main__target. svelte targetText; keen target_text.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the panel (svelte class, keen class) — class passthrough, not a core feature.

goldenConventions: The __value wrapper renders whenever any of value/prefix/unit is set; inside it the prefix __unit span comes first, then the __num, then the suffix __unit span (snippets/kpi.html L486). The __meta row renders whenever any of delta/period/target is set; its three cells are __delta, __period, __target in document order. In the snippet the three meta cells are <div>s, but both wrappers emit them as <span>s (svelte :if guards + keen :if guards both use <span>), so the blessed shape for the generated DOM is <span>; the snippet's <div> is reference-only. The __label renders only when set. Default variant emits NO modifier class (SCSS treats the bare .pa-kpi-hero-main as the base, with --positive merely re-selecting the same accent). The chart cell (__chart/__chart-svg) and the opt-in detail popover are out of scope (deferred prose). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

deferred.//: The sparkline cell + the opt-in detail popover. __chart wraps author-supplied chart content fed through a slot the generic dumper passes as plain escaped text; __chart-svg is the native fixed-height SVG host inside it — the SSR shells for that cell can't be exercised identically across both wrappers here, so both are acknowledged prose. The detail popover is the separate `.pa-kpi-detail` block (kpi-detail.json), opt-in (renders only when a detail title/slot is set), so no scenario here enables it.
deferred.pa-kpi-hero-main__chart: sparkline container (grows to fill spare height) — wraps author-supplied chart content fed through a slot (plain text in the dumper); deferred prose
deferred.pa-kpi-hero-main__chart-svg: fixed-height native SVG host inside __chart (avoids Y distortion) — author markup, not emitted by the component; deferred prose

features.//: Feature->class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-kpi-hero-main(--|__)'). Block modifiers in CSS: --positive/--negative/--neutral/--up-strong (all produced by the `variant` enum). Element classes in CSS: __label, __value, __num, __unit, __meta, __delta, __period, __target (all claimed by a feature's produces + exercised by a golden) and __chart, __chart-svg (deferred prose). produces:null = structural/native (no pa-kpi-hero-main modifier).
